passage.title: Bondi Beach
paragraphs: A. Bondi Beach, Australia's most famous beach, is located in the suburb of Bondi, in the Local Government Area of Waverley, seven kilometers from the centre of Sydney."Bondi" or "Boondi" is an Aboriginal word meaning water breaking over rocks or the sound of breaking waves. The Australian Museum records that Bondi means a place where a flight of nullas took place. There are Aboriginal Rock carving on the northern end of the beach at Ben Buckler and south of Bondi Beach near McKenzies Beach on the coastal walk.

B. The indigenous people of the area at the time of European settlement have generally been welcomed to as the Sydney people or the Eora (Eora means "the people"). One theory describes the Eora as a sub-group of the Darug language group which occupied the Cumberland Plain west to the Blue Mountains. However, another theory suggests that they were a distinct language group of their own. There is no clear evidence for the name or names of the particular band(s) of the Eora that roamed what is now the Waverley area. A number of place names within Waverley, most famously Bondi, have been based on words derived from Aboriginal languages of the Sydney region.

C. From the mid-1800s Bondi Beach was a favourite location for family outings and picnics. The beginnings of the suburb go back to 1809, when the early road builder, William Roberts, received from Governor Bligh a grant of 81 hectares of what is now most of the business and residential area of Bondi Beach. In 1851, Edward Smith Hall and Francis O'Brien purchased 200 acres of the Bondi area that embraced almost the whole frontage of Bondi Beach, and it was named the "The Bondi Estate." Between 1855 and 1877 O'Brien purchased Hall's share of the land, renamed the land the "O'Brien Estate," and made the beach and the surrounding land available to the public as a picnic ground and amusement resort. As the beach became increasingly popular, O'Brien threatened to stop public beach access. However, the Municipal Council believed that the Government needed to intervene to make the beach a public reserve.

D. During the 1900s beach became associated with health, leisure and democracy – a playground everyone could enjoy equally. Bondi Beach was a working-class suburb throughout most of the twentieth century with migrant people from New Zealand comprising the majority of the local population. The first tramway reached the beach in 1884. Following this, tram became the first public transportation in Bondi. As an alternative, this action changed the rule that only rich people can enjoy the beach.
By the 1930s Bondi was drawing not only local visitors but also people from elsewhere in Australia and overseas.
Advertising at the time referred to Bondi Beach as the "Playground of the Pacific".

E. There is a growing trend that people prefer having to relax near seaside instead of living unhealthily in cities. The increasing popularity of sea bathing during the late 1800s and early 1900s raised concerns about public safety and how to prevent people from drowning. In response, the world's first formally documented surf lifesaving club, the Bondi Surf Bathers' Life Saving Club, was formed in 1907. This was powerfully reinforced by the dramatic events of "Black Sunday" at Bondi in 1938. Some 35,000 people were on the beach and a large group of lifesavers were about to start a surf race when three freak waves hit the beach, sweeping hundreds of people out to sea. Lifesavers rescued 300 people. The largest mass rescue in the history of surf bathing, it confirmed the place of the lifesaver in the national imagination.

F. Bondi Beach is the endpoint of the City to Surf Fun Run which is held each year in August. Australian surf carnivals further instilled this image. A Royal Surf Carnival was held at Bondi Beach for Queen Elizabeth II during her first visited in Australia in 1954. Since 1867, there have been over fifty visits by a member of the British Royal Family to Australia. In addition to many activities, the Bondi Beach Markets is open every Sunday. Many wealthy people spend Christmas Day at the beach. However, the shortage of houses occurs when lots of people crushed to the seaside. Manly is the seashore town which solved this problem. However, people still choose Bondi as the satisfied destination rather than Manly.

G. Bondi Beach has a commercial area along Campbell Parade and adjacent side streets, featuring many popular cafes, restaurants, and hotels, with views of the contemporary beach. It is depicted as wholly modern and European. In the last decade, Bondi Beaches' unique position has seen a dramatic rise in svelte houses and apartments to take advantage of the views and scent of the sea. The valley running down to the beach is the famous world over for its view of distinctive red-tiled roofs. Those architectures are deeply influenced by British coastal town.

H. Bondi Beach hosted the beach volleyball competition at the 2000 Summer Olympics. A temporary 10,000-seat stadium, a much smaller stadium, 2 warm-up courts, and 3 training courts were set up to host the tournament. The Bondi Beach Volleyball Stadium was constructed for it and stood for just six weeks. Campaigners oppose both the social and environmental consequences of the development. The stadium will divide the beach in two and seriously restrict public access for swimming, walking, and other forms of outdoor recreation. People protest for their human rights of having a pure seaside and argue for health life in Bondi.

I."They're prepared to risk lives and risk the Bondi beach environment for the sake of eight days of volleyball", said Stephen Uniacke, a construction lawyer involved in the campaign. Other environmental concerns include the possibility that soil dredged up from below the sand will acidify when brought to the surface.

question_groups.instructions:
Do the following statements agree with the information given in Reading Passage 1? Choose
TRUE if the statement agrees with the information
FALSE if the statement contradicts the information
NOT GIVEN if there is no information on this.

questions.text: The name of the Bondi beach is first called by the British settlers.
questions.explanation:
Bước 1: Hiểu câu hỏi:
Tên "Bondi Beach" được người định cư Anh đặt ra đầu tiên.

Bước 2: Tìm các keywords được paraphrase trong bài:
name of Bondi ~ "'Bondi' or 'Boondi' is an Aboriginal word"
British settlers ~ không liên quan đến việc đặt tên

Bước 3: So sánh và đối chiếu:
Bài đọc chỉ rõ: ""Bondi" or "Boondi" is an Aboriginal word meaning water breaking over rocks or the sound of breaking waves" (tên Bondi xuất phát từ ngôn ngữ thổ dân, không phải người định cư Anh).
==> Điều này trái ngược với thông tin trong câu hỏi rằng người Anh đặt tên đầu tiên.

Bước 4: Đáp án: FALSE
quotes: "Bondi" or "Boondi" is an Aboriginal word meaning water breaking over rocks or the sound of breaking waves.

questions.text: The aboriginal culture in Australia is different when compared with European culture.
questions.explanation:
Bước 1: Hiểu câu hỏi:
Văn hóa thổ dân Úc khác biệt so với văn hóa châu Âu.

Bước 2: Tìm các keywords được paraphrase trong bài:
aboriginal culture ~ đoạn A, B đề cập thổ dân Eora, Aboriginal
different from European culture ~ không tìm thấy so sánh trực tiếp

Bước 3: So sánh và đối chiếu:
Bài đọc đề cập người thổ dân (Eora, Aboriginal) và người định cư châu Âu riêng lẻ.
==> Tuy nhiên, bài đọc không hề nhắc đến thông tin so sánh hay sự khác biệt giữa hai nền văn hóa.

Bước 4: Đáp án: NOT GIVEN
quotes: The indigenous people of the area at the time of European settlement have generally been welcomed to as the Sydney people or the Eora (Eora means "the people"). One theory describes the Eora as a sub-group of the Darug language group which occupied the Cumberland Plain west to the Blue Mountains.
"Bondi" or "Boondi" is an Aboriginal word meaning water breaking over rocks or the sound of breaking waves. The Australian Museum records that Bondi means a place where a flight of nullas took place.

questions.text: Bondi beach area holds many contemporary hotels
questions.explanation:
Bước 1: Hiểu câu hỏi:
Khu vực Bondi Beach có nhiều khách sạn hiện đại.

Bước 2: Tìm các keywords được paraphrase trong bài:
hotels ~ từ khóa giữ nguyên
contemporary hotels ~ không tìm thấy trong bài

Bước 3: So sánh và đối chiếu:
Bài đọc đoạn G đề cập: "featuring many popular cafes, restaurants, and hotels, with views of the contemporary beach".
==> "contemporary" trong bài bổ nghĩa cho "beach", không phải "hotels". Bài không xác nhận cũng không phủ nhận việc các khách sạn ở đây có phải là "contemporary" hay không.

Bước 4: Đáp án: NOT GIVEN
quotes: G. Bondi Beach has a commercial area along Campbell Parade and adjacent side streets, featuring many popular cafes, restaurants, and hotels, with views of the contemporary beach.

questions.text: The seaside town in Bondi is affected by British culture for its characteristic red color
questions.explanation:
Bước 1: Hiểu câu hỏi:
Thị trấn ven biển Bondi chịu ảnh hưởng của văn hóa Anh về màu đỏ đặc trưng.

Bước 2: Tìm các keywords được paraphrase trong bài:
affected by British culture ~ "deeply influenced by British coastal town"
characteristic red color ~ "distinctive red-tiled roofs"

Bước 3: So sánh và đối chiếu:
Bài đọc chỉ rõ: "The valley running down to the beach is famous world over for its view of distinctive red-tiled roofs. Those architectures are deeply influenced by British coastal town" (nổi tiếng thế giới với mái ngói đỏ đặc trưng chịu ảnh hưởng sâu sắc từ văn hóa Anh).
==> Điều này đồng nghĩa với thông tin trong câu hỏi rằng Bondi chịu ảnh hưởng Anh với màu đỏ đặc trưng.

Bước 4: Đáp án: TRUE
quotes: The valley running down to the beach is the famous world over for its view of distinctive red-tiled roofs. Those architectures are deeply influenced by British coastal town.

questions.text: Living near Bondi seashore is not beneficial for health.
questions.explanation:
Bước 1: Hiểu câu hỏi:
Sống gần bờ biển Bondi không có lợi cho sức khỏe.

Bước 2: Tìm các keywords được paraphrase trong bài:
beneficial for health ~ "beach became associated with health"
not beneficial ~ trái với nội dung bài

Bước 3: So sánh và đối chiếu:
Bài đọc chỉ rõ: "During the 1900s beach became associated with health, leisure and democracy" (bãi biển gắn liền với sức khỏe và giải trí).
==> Điều này trái ngược với thông tin trong câu hỏi rằng sống gần biển Bondi "không có lợi cho sức khỏe".

Bước 4: Đáp án: FALSE
quotes: D. During the 1900s beach became associated with health, leisure and democracy – a playground everyone could enjoy equally.

questions.text: At the end of the 19th century, which public transport did people use to go to Bondi?
questions.explanation:
Bước 1: Hiểu câu hỏi:
Cuối thế kỷ 19, người ta dùng phương tiện công cộng nào để đến Bondi?
Bước 2: Xác định loại từ dựa trên các dấu hiệu:
Loại từ: NOUN (phương tiện giao thông)
Dấu hiệu: "which public transport" → cần tên phương tiện.

Bước 3: Tìm các keywords được paraphrase trong bài:
• end of 19th century ~ "1884"
• public transport ~ "first public transportation in Bondi"

Bước 4: So sánh và đối chiếu:
Bài đọc chỉ rõ: "The first tramway reached the beach in 1884. Following this, tram became the first public transportation in Bondi" (xe điện là phương tiện công cộng đầu tiên ở Bondi từ năm 1884).

Bước 5: Đáp án: tram
quotes: The first tramway reached the beach in 1884. Following this, tram became the first public transportation in Bondi.

questions.text: When did the British Royalty first visit Bondi?
questions.explanation:
Bước 1: Hiểu câu hỏi:
Hoàng gia Anh lần đầu tiên đến thăm Bondi vào năm nào?
Bước 2: Xác định loại từ dựa trên các dấu hiệu:
Loại từ: NUMBER (năm)
Dấu hiệu: "When did" → cần năm/thời gian.

Bước 3: Tìm các keywords được paraphrase trong bài:
• British Royalty first visit ~ "Royal Surf Carnival was held at Bondi Beach for Queen Elizabeth II during her first visited in Australia"
• Bondi ~ từ khóa giữ nguyên

Bước 4: So sánh và đối chiếu:
Bài đọc chỉ rõ: "A Royal Surf Carnival was held at Bondi Beach for Queen Elizabeth II during her first visited in Australia in 1954" (Hoàng gia Anh lần đầu đến Bondi năm 1954).

Bước 5: Đáp án: 1954
quotes: A Royal Surf Carnival was held at Bondi Beach for Queen Elizabeth II during her first visited in Australia in 1954.

questions.text: Which Olympic event did Bondi hold in the 2000 Sydney Olympic games?
questions.explanation:
Bước 1: Hiểu câu hỏi:
Bondi tổ chức môn thi đấu Olympic nào tại Sydney 2000?
Bước 2: Xác định loại từ dựa trên các dấu hiệu:
Loại từ: NOUN PHRASE (tên môn thể thao)
Dấu hiệu: "which Olympic event" → cần tên môn thi đấu.

Bước 3: Tìm các keywords được paraphrase trong bài:
• 2000 Sydney Olympic ~ từ khóa giữ nguyên
• Bondi hold ~ "Bondi Beach hosted"

Bước 4: So sánh và đối chiếu:
Bài đọc chỉ rõ: "Bondi Beach hosted the beach volleyball competition at the 2000 Summer Olympics" (Bondi tổ chức thi đấu bóng chuyền bãi biển).

Bước 5: Đáp án: beach volleyball
quotes: H. Bondi Beach hosted the beach volleyball competition at the 2000 Summer Olympics.

questions.text: What would be damaged if the stadium was built for that Olympic event?
questions.explanation:
Bước 1: Hiểu câu hỏi:
Điều gì sẽ bị tổn hại nếu sân vận động được xây dựng?
Bước 2: Xác định loại từ dựa trên các dấu hiệu:
Loại từ: NOUN (thứ cụ thể bị tổn hại)
Dấu hiệu: "What would be damaged" → cần danh từ cụ thể, không phải khái niệm chung.

Bước 3: Tìm các keywords được paraphrase trong bài:
• damaged ~ "acidify"
• if the stadium was built ~ "Other environmental concerns"

Bước 4: So sánh và đối chiếu:
Bài đọc chỉ rõ: "the possibility that soil dredged up from below the sand will acidify when brought to the surface" (đất bị đào lên từ dưới cát sẽ bị axit hóa — đây là thứ cụ thể bị tổn hại).

Bước 5: Đáp án: soil | environment
quotes: "They're prepared to risk lives and risk the Bondi beach environment for the sake of eight days of volleyball", said Stephen Uniacke, a construction lawyer involved in the campaign.

questions.text: Bondi beach holds the feature sports activities every year, which attracts lots of ____ (10) choosing to live at this place during the holidays.
questions.explanation:
Bước 1: Hiểu câu hỏi và Giải thích ngữ pháp:
Bondi thu hút nhiều ______ chọn sống ở đây trong kỳ nghỉ.
Bước 2: Xác định loại từ dựa trên các dấu hiệu:
Loại từ: NOUN PHRASE (chỉ người)
Dấu hiệu: "attracts lots of ______" → cần danh từ chỉ người.

Bước 3: Tìm các keywords được paraphrase trong bài:
• choosing to live during holidays ~ "spend Christmas Day at the beach"
• attracts lots of ~ "crushed to the seaside"

Bước 4: So sánh và đối chiếu:
Bài đọc chỉ rõ: "Many wealthy people spend Christmas Day at the beach. However, the shortage of houses occurs when lots of people crushed to the seaside" (nhiều người giàu đến đây trong kỳ nghỉ gây thiếu nhà ở).

Bước 5: Đáp án: wealthy people
quotes: As an alternative, this action changed the rule that only rich people can enjoy the beach. By the 1930s Bondi was drawing not only local visitors but also people from elsewhere in Australia and overseas.

questions.text: a nearby town of ____ (11) is the first suburb site to support the solution
questions.explanation:
Bước 1: Hiểu câu hỏi và Giải thích ngữ pháp:

Bước 3: Tìm các keywords được paraphrase trong bài:

• support the solution ~ "solved this problem"

Bước 4: So sánh và đối chiếu:
Bài đọc chỉ rõ: "Manly is the seashore town which solved this problem" (Manly là thị trấn ven biển đã giải quyết vấn đề thiếu nhà ở).

quotes: Manly is the seashore town which solved this problem.

questions.text: yet people prefer ____ (12) as their best choice.
